personality: A grey-skinned Jotunas goliath woman, her stone-pale markings running down her arms, her black hair in long braids, with a rune-cut great axe and a round shield slung beside her snowshoes. Loud, warm and blunt, she treats every fight as a contest she fully intends to win. The Keepers pulled her raiding band out of a goblin warren, and she pays that debt in blood and laughter.
inAFight: Get in before the enemy acts (Ambush Strike), rage on the first swing with Reckless and Brutal, and Whirlwind when three crowd you. When the troll drops, oil the axe with fire or throw a flask before it gets up.
abilitiesText:
**Rage.** As part of an attack or your move, rage for the rest of the encounter, 4 times a day. While raging, +2 melee weapon damage. It ends early if a full round passes without you attacking or taking damage.

**Rage Styles.** Each time you rage, choose two for that rage. Reckless: Advantage on your first attack roll each round, but attacks against you have Advantage. Brutal: once a round when you hit, shove the target 10ft or knock it Prone (Fortitude save, DC 17). Terrifying: once per rage, use Intimidate as part of an attack instead of your action.

**Whirlwind Attack.** Once per rage, while raging, replace your action: one attack roll against each of up to 3 opponents within 5ft whose Level is 4 or lower. You cannot have retreated first.

**Extra Attack.** When you use your action to attack, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

**Intimidate (Strength).** Uses your action. One creature of Level 9 or lower within 15ft makes a Will save (DC 17) or has Disadvantage on attack rolls for 1d4 rounds. No daily limit.

**Primeval Will.** Once a day, when you drop to 18 HP or less, gain 18 bonus HP, lost first and gone when combat ends. If you drop to 0 or below first, it triggers by itself; at 1 HP or more after it, keep fighting. It cannot stop a blow that kills you outright.

**Ancestral Calling.** The first time you rage each day, allies within 30ft gain 9 temporary HP until the end of the day.

**Force of Nature.** +1 to saves against spells and magical effects.

**Iron Sinews.** Your weapon attacks count as magic.

**Combat Sense.** Advantage on checks to avoid being surprised. Attackers gain no Advantage on you from flanking or from being Unseen, and rear-attack bonuses such as Back Attack do not work on you.

**Thick Hide.** +2 AC in light armour or none (included).

**Primeval Instincts.** Out of medium and heavy armour, Advantage on Strength, Dexterity and Constitution checks in extreme circumstances. Hold your breath twice as long, and climb natural slopes and swim rivers at half speed without a check.

**Kit: Ambush Strike.** Advantage on your first attack roll each round against a target that hasn't yet acted in combat.

**Kit: Desert Born.** Advantage on Survival checks in arid or desert terrain, and on checks to identify Red Waste tribal markings or customs.

**Goliath (Jotunas).** Large: a 10ft space, 5ft more melee reach and no Heavy weapon Disadvantage, but Disadvantage on Stealth and in tight spaces. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to cold. Advantage on Strength checks to push, drag, lift or break against something smaller. Advantage on Jotunas terrain, tribal-custom and giant-lineage checks, and on Charisma checks towards Dul Khagul dwarves.

**Mountain Endurance.** Once a day, when hit, reduce the damage by 1d12+3 (1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Fortitude saves against exhaustion, forced marching and thin mountain air.

**Toughness (1st, General).** +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Critical Strike (2nd, Martial).** Your weapon attacks score a Critical Hit on a natural 20, or on a natural 19 that hits.

**Flowing Strikes (6th, Martial).** Once a round, when you hit with a melee attack, make one more melee attack: with Disadvantage against the creature you hit, a normal roll against a different one in reach. It can't trigger itself.

**HP.** 1st level: d12 max 12 + Con 3 = 15. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (7 + 3) = 80. Toughness: 9. Total 104.

personality: A blonde half-elf duellist in a sea-blue cloak, rapier in one hand and a long parrying dagger at her hip, who learned her footwork on the docks and decks of Opal. Teasing, theatrical and quick to apologise to the foe she has just embarrassed. She joined the Keepers for a steady fee and a good story, and stayed because they are the only crew she trusts at her back.
inAFight: Pick one foe and keep it to yourself for Duel's Rhythm, then hit it again and again for Relentless Assault. Parry the big blows, Riposte the misses, and dance clear with Hit and Run and Acrobatic Escape.
abilitiesText:
**Flourish Manoeuvres.** Once a round, out of turn, one of these. Parry: when struck in melee, a Dexterity check (d20+4) against the attack roll; succeed and the hit is negated. Riposte: when an enemy misses you in melee, make a free attack against it. Acrobatic Escape: when hit, a Dexterity check against the attack roll; succeed to halve the damage and move 20ft (kit) without provoking. No Parry with a shield or in medium or heavy armour.

**Finesse.** Dexterity for attack and damage with light or finesse melee weapons.

**Agile Defence.** +2 AC in light armour or none, with no shield (included).

**Opening Flourish.** Your first hit each encounter adds your Charisma modifier (+2) to damage.

**Duel's Rhythm.** While in melee with a single opponent and no one else in reach, Advantage on your first attack roll each round and on saves.

**Light Feet.** Creatures you attacked this turn can't make Attacks of Opportunity as you move away.

**Hit and Run.** On a turn you attack, +10ft speed, and once a round you may move through one enemy's space without provoking Attacks of Opportunity.

**En Garde.** Advantage on initiative rolls.

**Relentless Assault.** Each hit after the first on the same target in a round adds +1d4 damage.

**Extra Attack.** When you use your action to attack, make one more weapon attack, with Disadvantage.

**Disarming Strike.** On a hit, instead of dealing damage, the target makes a Fortitude save (DC 18) or drops what it holds. It counts as your attack for that round.

**Flèche.** 4 times a day, as part of your action, lunge for one more melee attack, with Disadvantage.

**Kit: Deckhand's Escape.** Acrobatic Escape moves you 20ft, on any terrain without penalty.

**Kit: Dockside Rapport.** Advantage on Seamanship checks and on Charisma checks with sailors, dock workers and maritime merchants.

**Half-Elf.** Low-light vision. Immune to magical sleep; Advantage on saves against charm and on social checks with humans and elves. Fully rested after a 4-hour trance or 8 hours' sleep. Knack: Advantage on Etiquette checks.

**Dual Heritage.** Once a day, reroll one failed save or check (1 Luck for a second use).

**Two-Weapon Fighting (1st, Specialist).** Your off-hand attack has no Disadvantage.

**Swift Reflexes (2nd, General).** +1 Dexterity (included) and Advantage on initiative.

**Toughness (6th, General).** +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

**HP.** 1st level: d8 max 8 + Con 1 = 9. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (5 + 1) = 48. Toughness: 9. Total 66.

spells.notes:
Sacred Flame (cantrip): 60ft, one creature you can see: 2d4 radiant, Reflex DC 17 negates; cover gives no bonus to the save.
Toll the Dead (cantrip): 60ft, one creature: 2d4 necrotic, or 2d6 if it is below its maximum HP; Will DC 17 negates.
First Aid (cantrip): touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll. It stays Unconscious and regains no HP.
Light (cantrip): touch an object: bright light 20ft and dim light 20ft more, for 9 hours.
Detect Magic (cantrip, ritual): self, 60ft cone, 9 rounds: see which creatures and objects carry magic, and the school of the strongest aura.
Cure Light Wounds (1st): touch: heals 1d8+6 (1d8+5, +1 from Healer).
Bless (1st): 50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on the first attack roll each round and +1 to saves. Reversed (Bane) on 6 enemies, Will DC 17 negates.
Command (1st): 30ft, one creature that understands you: Approach, Drop, Flee or Halt on its next turn. Will DC 17 negates; mindless creatures are immune.
Guiding Bolt (1st): 120ft, one creature: 3d8 radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves. The next attack roll on it before the end of your next turn has Advantage (a save negates that).
Aid (2nd): touch, 9 minutes: Advantage on the first attack roll each round, +1 to saves and 1d8 temporary HP. Not with Bless.
Hold Person (2nd): 120ft, one humanoid (hobgoblins count): Paralysed for 9 rounds, repeating the save each turn. Will DC 17 negates.
Spiritual Weapon (2nd): 60ft, 9 rounds: on each of your turns it hits one creature within 5ft of it for 1d6+3 force, no roll. Move it 30ft a round; AC 15, 10 HP.
Cure Serious Wounds (3rd): touch: heals 2d8+11 (2d8+9, +2 from Healer).
Prayer (3rd): 40ft radius on you, 9 rounds: allies have Advantage on their first attack roll each round and +1 to damage and saves; enemies have Disadvantage and -1. No save.
Spirit Guardians (3rd): self, 15ft radius that moves with you, 9 rounds: enemies entering or starting their turn in it move at half speed and take 1d6 radiant or necrotic (chosen on casting), once a round. Will DC 17 halves.
Healing Circle (4th): 30ft, 20ft-radius burst: every living creature in it heals 1d8+10 (1d8+9, +1 from Healer). Mind the foes in the burst.
Flame Strike (5th): 60ft, 10ft-radius, 40ft-high cylinder: 9d6, half fire and half radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves. Fire, for the troll.

personality: A dark-skinned aasimar priestess of Lathander who blazes with dawn light when she prays, and brings her warhammer down like a sunrise breaking. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn, she believes every bad night ends in a morning. She joined the Keepers because Burrow's Den needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.
inAFight: Open with Bless or Prayer, then keep everyone standing: Spirit Guardians when foes close in, Healing Circle when the whole line is hurt. Save Flame Strike for the troll, whose fire keeps it down.
abilitiesText:
**Spell Use.** Wisdom caster, spell DC 17. Each morning prepare 12 spells from the Cleric list (level 9 + Wisdom 3); your 5 cantrips are extra. Slots: 1st 5, 2nd 5, 3rd 4, 4th 2, 5th 1 (Wisdom bonus slots included).

**Turn Undead.** As an action, 6 times a day, present your holy symbol: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save (DC 17). On a failure it is destroyed if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned.

**Perfect Recall.** Once a day, with a DC 10 Wisdom check, recast a 1st-level spell you have already cast, without a slot.

**Banish.** Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as a Cleric 4 levels lower. One that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned.

**Divine Monolith.** A permanent 10ft aura that can't be dispelled: you and allies in it have Advantage on Will saves, and undead have Disadvantage on saves against your Turn Undead.

**Kit: Granted Power (Lathander).** Advantage on your first attack roll each round against undead. Once a day, a 20ft burst of dawn light: undead in it make a Will save or flee for 1 minute.

**Weapon Selection.** The whole Cleric weapon list (your war hammer is on it), plus Lathander's favoured heavy mace.

**Aasimar.** Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant. Advantage on saves against being Frightened. Once a day, shed bright light in a 10ft radius; once a day, Lay on Hands to heal 9 HP. Knack: Advantage on Singing checks.

**Healer (1st, Arcane & Devout).** Healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included in the spell lines). Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

**War Caster (4th, Arcane & Devout).** Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep a spell when you take damage, and you cast with hammer and shield in hand.

**Toughness (8th, General).** +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

**HP.** 1st level: d8 max 8 + Con 2 = 10. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (5 + 2) = 56. Toughness: 9. Total 75.

weapons.notes: Light. Misfires on a natural 1 or 2. Lightning Reload: reloads as part of the attack that fired it, once a round. Quick Draw: drawing it loaded costs nothing. Steady Shot: +1d6 on your first hit each round while Dead Eye applies.

weapons.name: Long Rifle
weapons.notes: Armour Piercing: ignores 2 points of AC from armour. Misfires on a natural 1. Reload 3 rounds with Lightning Reload: open with it from range, then go to the pistol.

weapons.notes: A ranged attack against AC (Dexterity). Fire, for the troll. Five flasks share a slot.

personality: A white-haired marksman in spectacles and a long blue coat, with a long rifle across his shoulders and a pistol never far from his hand. Dry, patient and precise, he spent years on Fort Dunwell's Wall watching the Red Waste for movement, and he still counts every shot.
inAFight: Stand still and shoot: Dead Eye gives Advantage on your first shot each round and Steady Shot adds 1d6. Open with the long rifle, Quick Draw the pistol for the Extra Attack, and stop chargers with Brace and Fire.
hook: Your niece Rook Halloway went into the dark with the Recruits; tonight you find them, and her, dead.
abilitiesText:
**Dead Eye.** Advantage on your first ranged attack roll each round, on a turn you don't move. Once you attack with it you are rooted until the end of your turn.

**Steady Shot.** While Dead Eye applies, your first hit each round deals +1d6.

**Dead Aim.** Aim without moving or acting for a round (Patient Aim): your next shot this combat has Advantage and +1d6 damage, stacking with Steady Shot. If you are interrupted, the bonus is lost but not the rounds.

**Quick Draw.** Drawing a loaded pistol doesn't use your free object use.

**Lightning Reload.** Your blackpowder weapons reload one round faster, at best as part of the attack that fired them, once a round.

**Extra Attack.** When you use your action to attack, make one more attack, with Disadvantage. Each shot needs a loaded gun.

**Called Shot.** Declare before rolling and take Disadvantage; one a round. Head: Fortitude save (DC 18) or Stunned for 1 round. Arm: Fortitude save or it drops what it holds. Leg: Fortitude save or its movement is halved for 1 round.

**Perfect Shot.** Once a day, declare before rolling: your next ranged attack deals maximum damage if it hits. A maximised die doesn't explode.

**Trick Shot (Dexterity).** One impossible-looking shot a round (round a corner, off a wall, cut a rope, disarm within 30ft) against a DC the GM sets. A failure simply misses.

**Brace and Fire.** Once a round, out of turn, shoot a charging creature before it reaches you, without Dead Eye's stand-still rule. On a hit it makes a Fortitude save (DC 18) or its charge stops.

**Grit.** Once a day, when dropped to 0 HP or below, make a Fortitude save (DC 10 + the damage below 0). On a success you stay at 1 HP and conscious.

**Firearm Proficiency.** No Disadvantage with blackpowder weapons, and their damage dice explode.

**Kit: Patient Aim.** Dead Aim needs only 1 round of aiming instead of 2.

**Kit: Sentry's Eye.** Advantage on checks to estimate range or identify targets at a distance, and on Perception during watch or sentry duty.

**Human.** Knack: Advantage on Tracking checks. A bonus General feat at 1st level (Toughness). Trained in light and medium armour.

**Toughness (1st, Human bonus, General).** +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Steady Aim (1st, Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks against a target in melee with an ally.

**Point-Blank Terror (2nd, Specialist).** No Disadvantage on ranged attacks with an enemy within 5ft.

**Swift Reflexes (6th, General).** +1 Dexterity (included) and Advantage on initiative.

**HP.** 1st level: d8 max 8 + Con 2 = 10. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (5 + 2) = 56. Toughness: 9. Total 75.

When you attack, add your second unarmed strike (+9, 1d6+3). Flowing Strikes: once a round after a hit, one more melee attack.

weapons.name: Fist
weapons.notes: Unarmed strikes, Strength or Dexterity. Magic (Iron Fists); lethal or subdual, your choice. Parrying Stance only while you fight unarmed.

weapons.name: Alchemist's Fire (flask)
weapons.damage: 1d6 fire, and the target is Burning (1d6 fire at the start of each of its turns until doused)
weapons.notes: A ranged attack against AC (Dexterity). Fire, for the troll. Five flasks share a slot.

personality: A blue-scaled dragonborn with a long staff, a red sash and a crackle of lightning behind his teeth. Calm and dry-humoured, he speaks softly, laughs at thunder and follows his own conscience over any law. Kiyo's students walk with the Keepers, and Sarrix has walked with them longer than most.
inAFight: Close fast at 50ft, strike with the staff and a second unarmed blow, and try a Stun Attack on the most dangerous foe. Breathe lightning down a line of enemies, and turn aside arrows and blades with Deflect Missiles and Deflect Blow.
abilitiesText:
**Fast Movement and AC.** Speed 50ft and AC 16 from the Monk table (Dexterity does not add), plus 1 for your ring. Armour or a shield replaces the table AC; over your carrying limit you lose Fast Movement and move at 30ft.

**Hand-to-Hand Combat.** Unarmed strikes deal 1d10 using Strength or Dexterity, lethal or subdual as you choose. When you use your action to attack, you also make a second unarmed strike (1d6), rolled normally. Advantage on all grappling and overbearing attacks. A Monk never gains Extra Attack.

**Weapon Mastery (staff).** +1 to attack and damage with your staff (included); once a round, reroll one missed attack with it. Stun Attack and Deflect Missiles work through it.

**Stun Attack.** Declare before the attack roll, once a round, 9 times a day; a miss still counts. On a hit the target makes a Fortitude save (DC 16) or is Stunned for 1 round. Your first stun attempt must be a primary attack.

**Parrying Stance.** While unarmed and unarmoured, once a round when struck in melee, add +2 (Wisdom) to your AC against that attack, after the attacker rolls.

**Deflect Missiles and Deflect Blow (Dexterity).** 2 attempts a round, out of turn. When hit by a nonmagical ranged weapon (with a hand free), or struck in melee, make a Dexterity check (d20+0) against the attack roll; succeed and it is negated entirely.

**Catch Weapon (Dexterity).** Once a round, out of turn, when struck in melee, a Dexterity check against the attack roll catches the weapon.

**Iron Discipline.** +3 to saves against disease, poison, paralysis, polymorph, petrification and death attacks (Iron Body), and against confusion, charm, fear and mind-affecting spells (Iron Mind).

**Iron Fists.** Your unarmed strikes count as magic weapons.

**Slow Fall.** Within 10ft of a wall as you fall, treat the fall as 30ft shorter.

**Ascetic Recovery.** Feign Death for up to 9 minutes. Fast Healing: once a day, after a long rest, regain 9 HP.

**Body of Iron.** Once a day, at the start of your turn, end one condition on yourself (Stunned, Paralysed, Poisoned, Frightened, Charmed and the like). No action, and it works while Incapacitated.

**Kit: Dragon's Reflex.** A natural 15 or higher on your Deflect Blow check succeeds, whatever the attack roll.

**Kit: Kiyo's Legacy.** Advantage on checks to identify or learn about The Omniscience and its agents; the Keepers of Tariel know you as an ally on sight.

**Dragonborn (Lightning).** Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to lightning. Once a day, breathe lightning in a line or cone: 9 damage, Reflex save (DC 15) for half (1 Luck for another use). Advantage on Charisma checks towards dragon-kin and true dragons.

**Toughness (1st, General).** +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

**Flowing Strikes (2nd, Martial).** Once a round, when you hit with a melee attack, make one more melee attack: with Disadvantage against the creature you hit, a normal roll against a different one in reach.

**Alertness (6th, Specialist).** You can't be surprised by nonmagical means, and +2 to initiative.

**HP.** 1st level: d10 max 10 + Con 1 = 11. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (6 + 1) = 56. Toughness: 9. Total 76.
